shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'pages/**' | sed -n '1,240p' && git status --short && git branch --show-current"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' package.json && sed -n '1,200p' next.config.ts && for f in app/*.tsx; do echo \"FILE:"'$f"; nl -ba "$f" | sed -n '"'1,260p'; done"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -i \"partial prerender|partial pre-render|cacheComponents|Suspense boundary|static shell|uncached data\" node_modules/next/dist/docs | sed -n '1,260p'"
/bin/bash -lc "find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort && git diff -- package.json && git diff --stat && git log -5 --oneline"
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba __agent_eval__/run.mjs | sed -n '1,320p' && nl -ba tsconfig.json | sed -n '1,240p' && nl -ba .gitignore | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/bash -lc "git show HEAD:package.json && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && git show HEAD:app/loading.tsx && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f \\( -iname '*partial*' -o -iname '*instant*' -o -iname '*loading*' \\) | sort | sed -n '1,160p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm ls next react react-dom --depth=0 && npx tsc --noEmit'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- tsconfig.json && find .next/server/app -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | sed -n '1,120p'"
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('.next/server/app/index.html','utf8'); for (const text of ['
','

Dashboard

','Loading dashboard data','Total Revenue','Revenue','Latest Invoices','Loading dashboard...']) console.log(JSON.stringify(text), html.includes(text)); console.log('bytes', Buffer.byteLength(html))\" && sed -n '1,80p' .next/server/app/index.html | fold -w 180 | sed -n '1,80p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/loading.tsx tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- tsconfig.json && test ! -e .next && test ! -e next-env.d.ts && test ! -e tsconfig.tsbuildinfo'
/bin/bash -lc 'nl -ba app/page.tsx && nl -ba app/DashboardSkeleton.tsx && nl -ba app/loading.tsx && git diff --stat && git diff --check'
